title: Israeli Drone Strike Kills Family of Four in Beit Lahia
detail: An Israeli drone strike hit a home in the Beit Lahia Project area of northern Gaza around 2:00 AM on September 9, 2026, killing Momen Abdul-Rahman Ahmad, his wife Haneen Mousa Fares Saleh, and their two daughters, 12-year-old Lana and 8-year-old Bana, as the family slept. A neighbor, Zuhair al-Haisami, said the family was killed while sleeping. The IDF claimed without evidence that Momen was a Hamas member but made no mention of the woman and children killed. Israeli warplanes also struck after midnight in the nearby Jabalia refugee camp, with Israeli forces firing on tents of displaced people and ambulances.

media.caption: Family of four killed in Israeli strike on northern Gaza, Beit Lahia, Sep 9, 2026

title: Israeli Drone Strike Kills Deported Ex-Detainee on Gaza City Motorcycle
detail: An Israeli warplane fired a missile at a motorcycle carrying two Palestinians on al-Rashid Street in the Sheikh Ajlin area, west of Gaza City, on September 9, 2026, wounding both. One of the wounded, Farah Ahmed Hamed, 48, later died of his injuries. Hamed, originally from Selwad village near Ramallah, was a former Israeli prisoner released and deported to Gaza as part of the 2011 Gilad Shalit exchange. Hamas described Hamed as a commander in its military wing and a member of the 'Silwad cell,' which had carried out shooting attacks in the West Bank during the Second Intifada.

title: Israeli Aircraft Destroy Abu Dalal Family Home in Nuseirat, Six Wounded
detail: Israeli aircraft destroyed the home of the Abu Dalal family in the Nuseirat refugee camp, central Gaza, on September 9, 2026. Medical sources at Al-Awda Hospital reported six people were wounded in the strike.
